paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Judahte kumpipa Jekoniah, Jehoiakim tapa leh Judah heutute, mikhutsiamte leh siksek mite toh Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon sal dia api nung in, TOUPA'N hiai mengmuhna ahon ensak a, ngai dih, theipi bawm nih TOUPA tempul ma ah akitung hi.
heading: Theipi Bawm Nih Muhna
english: Yahweh showed me, and behold, two baskets of figs set before Yahweh’s temple, after that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

paite: Bawm khat ah theipi hoihtak, theipi min masa bangtak a-om a; bawm dang ah bel theipi hoih lou, nek tak louh khop a sia a-om hi.
english: One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Bang ahia na muh, Jeremiah?" achi a. Ke'n, "Theipi, theipi hoih, hoih mahmah; leh ahoih lou, nek tak louh khop a sia," ka chi hi.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, What do you see, Jeremiah? I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the bad, very bad, that can’t be eaten, they are so bad.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: The word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Judah saltangte, Kaldaite gam a athahna ding ua ka sawlkhiakte, hiai theipi hoih bang in ka en ding hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: Like these good figs, so will I regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, for good.

paite: Ahoihna ding un atung uah ka mit ka tusak ding a, hiai gam ah ka pikik nawn ding; amau ka dingsak ding a, ka phel kei ding; ka suan ding a, ka botkhe kei ding.
english: For I will set my eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na hon theihna ding in lungtang ka hon pe ding a; ka mite ahi ding ua, a Pathian uh ka hi ding; alungtang tengteng uh toh ka kiang ah ahong kik ding uhi."
english: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am Yahweh: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God; for they shall return to me with their whole heart.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Theipi sia, nek tak louh khop a sia bang in Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leh aheutute uh leh Jerusalem a nituang hiai gam a omlaite leh Aigupta gam a tengte, ka lehngatsan ding hi.
english: As the bad figs, which can’t be eaten, they are so bad, surely thus says Yahweh, So will I give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt,

paite: Haksatak a leitung gam teng lak ah sep leng ding in, ka delhmangnate gensiat leh tehpih leh tai leh hamsiatkhum hi ding in ka tawpsan ding.
english: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil; to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I shall drive them.

paite: Amau leh apate uh kiang a ka piak gam a kipan valh khit ahih tanpha un alak uah namsau, kial leh hii ka sawl ding hi."
english: I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, until they be consumed from off the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.
